subject: Pixel extraction from images without a CRS

messages.author: 231db58720d694e3
messages.subject: Pixel extraction from images without a CRS
parts:
Dr. Matias

I am working with fixed position, low altitude multispectral images. Thus, the multispectral image analysis with FIELDimageR does not work correctly since there is no projection (even if the projection is labeled as false).

However, in the seed counting tutorial (presented here:https://filipematias23.github.io/FIELDimageR-Workshop-5/#thresholding) it would seem that this process would allow for individual "object" pixel extraction with the correct lines of code.

Have you done any pixel extraction using this methodology? Perhaps have any additional insight on the subject?

Thank you so much in advance

EJ

messages.subject: Re: Pixel extraction from images without a CRS
parts:
Filipe

Attached is the code and TIFF file.

EX1 <- stack("IMG_0046_merged.tiff")
EX1.Crop <- fieldCrop(mosaic = EX1)
EX1.BGI<- fieldMask(mosaic = EX1.Crop, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, 
                    index = "BGI", cropValue = 0.6, cropAbove = T)
EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.BGI,ncols = 6, nrows = 8)
EX1.Indices <- fieldIndex(EX1.Shape$newMosaic,Red=1,Green=2,Blue=3,RedEdge=4, ###Indices####
                             index = c("GLI"))
EX1.Info<- fieldInfo(mosaic = EX1.Indices$GLI,
                     fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape@data,
                     projection = F,
                     n.core = 3)

Thank you 

EJ

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Pixel extraction from images without a CRS
parts:
Hi EJ,

It's not working because you are using fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape@data. 

@data is a dataset and not a shapefile. You only need to remove it from your code and use fieldShape = EX1.Shape$fieldShape

Here is the code that worked for me:

library(FIELDimageR)
library(raster)

EX1 <- stack("IMG_0046_merged.tiff")
EX1.Crop <- fieldCrop(mosaic = EX1)
EX1.BGI<- fieldMask(mosaic = EX1.Crop, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, 
                    index = "BGI", cropValue = 0.6, cropAbove = T)
EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.BGI,ncols = 6, nrows = 8)

Please, let me know if it works.

All the best,
Filipe
